author: Matilda Bernelid
quote: Super nice staff, good customer service as soon as you step inside the door. Great sushi burritos. Will definitely eat there again. Strongly recommend 🤩

author: Jeanette Cabezas
quote: Nice staff who assured us that we would be full and therefore did not need to buy "waiting food" ....we were really full....so good....so crispy ...so affordable!

author: Kia
quote: One of the most busy Sushi outlet. It is because of their attractive deals mainly. There is a seating arrangement but not for many.
